caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile with a predominantly cream-colored background. The textile is decorated with horizontal bands and bird-like motifs. There are four main wide horizontal bands composed of alternating red, blue, and white stripes, with the blue stripes being the thickest. Between these bands, the cream-colored field is decorated with repeating arrow or bird-shaped motifs in red and blue, arranged in rows and oriented horizontally. Smaller diamond or dot-shaped elements in red are also interspersed among the motifs. A visible seam runs vertically down the center of the textile, suggesting it is made from two pieces joined together. The edges of the textile are slightly uneven. The overall arrangement forms a pattern of alternating bands and motif-decorated fields.
title: Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
